question: Does disabling Blender 5.2 output dithering restore exact decoded-pixel reproducibility for the complete B02 Eevee review proxy?

intervention.application: Set bpy.context.scene.render.dither_intensity in memory before invoking the frozen B14 renderer

decisionRule.CAUSAL_SUPPORT_DITHER: D0 A/B passes exact decoded pixels and all controls/attacks pass, while frozen B15 baseline remains non-exact
decisionRule.DITHER_NOT_SUFFICIENT: D0 A/B contains any decoded pixel difference with a valid experiment
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any identity, control, invariant or attack gate fails

explicitNonClaims: A dither-zero exact result would show that dither is necessary for the observed B15 variation under this profile; it would not prove every Blender nondeterminism source is eliminated.
Disabling dither may increase visible banding and is not automatically the preferred artistic review setting.
The experiment does not select a perceptual tolerance.
Eevee 8-bit proxy behavior is not Cycles EXR master behavior.
Same-machine evidence is not cross-device evidence.
